dataset.name: nvidia/TechQA-RAG-Eval
dataset.split_rule: The Hugging Face viewer exposes one split named train. Question ids already carry the original TechQA prefixes: DEV_ is dev (310) and TRAIN_ is test (600). No question was moved after a retrieval score.
dataset.passage_rule: One passage per corpus file. A question is relevant to the filenames listed in contexts. is_impossible questions have an empty context list and no relevant passage.

bm25: SQLite FTS5. Documents keep every token. Queries use the production 80-token cap.
note: Test split refuses knob overrides. Unanswerable questions are excluded from Recall, MRR, and nDCG. sqlite-vec is not used because its KNN k limit is 4096.
